title: GDEC Phase C Refusal Schema & Priority Matrix

priority_order.meaning: Requested QoI is mathematically divergent or undefined in the continuous formulation
GDEC does not currently support the requested functional in H1 elasticity
Geometric domain contains overlapping, degenerate, or self-intersecting boundaries
Mesh contains triangles with minimum interior angle below validated threshold
Linear solver relative backward error / residual exceeds validated tolerance
Insufficient valid nested mesh levels available to evaluate GCI
Consecutive mesh QoI differences are unresolved relative to numerical precision floor
Observed convergence order p_obs is outside the validated plausibility window [0.5, 3.5]
Convergence sequence violates monotonicity (d01 * d12 <= 0) or divergence criteria (q <= 1)
Computational resource limit reached before estimated uncertainty satisfied requested tolerance
